feedback.end: Deserts are regions that get very little rain: no more than 25 centimetres per year!

atoms.word: d e s e r t

instruction.text: Do you know what the desert looks like? Select different parts of the habitat to learn more.

hint.text: What is a habitat? A habitat is an animal’s home. It can be large like a group of mountains, or small like a pond.

feedback.correct: Some deserts have large sand dunes.
Deserts are normally very hot during the day and become very cool at night. However, there are also some entirely cold deserts, like in Greenland.

instruction.text: Which photo shows the desert? Select the correct picture.

correct.text: Most plants would struggle to grow in the desert because of the lack of water.
Some plants, like this cactus, have adapted to grow in the desert.
This is a desert in Australia. You can find kangaroos in this kind of desert.
